entities.summary: Aryan Khan is an Indian entrepreneur and filmmaker. After graduating from the University of Southern California, he co-founded the company SLAB Ventures in 2022, under which he launched a luxury lifestyle and beverage brand named D'YAVOL. He is the oldest son of Shah Rukh Khan and Gauri Khan.
